# MedPREP

> MedPREP is an exam preparation platform for Pakistani medical students, with an MCQ bank, structured notes and flashcards. It is built for students of Khyber Medical University (KMU) and is expanding across Pakistan. MedPREP is operated by Exonovo in Abbottabad, Pakistan.

Tagline: Where Pakistan's Best Doctors Begin.

## What it offers
- MCQ bank (7,800+ MCQs for 4th year in 2026, expanding where gaps are found) with a full explanation for every question: why the right answer is right, why each wrong option is wrong, the trap and a high-yield pearl
- Tutor, Timed and Exam study modes and a custom session builder
- OSPE preparation: image-based slide stations for Eye and ENT, instrument stations, theory cheat sheets for the viva, and pharmacology prescriptions
- Structured notes aligned to university syllabi
- Flashcards, including cards generated from wrongly answered MCQs
- Syllabus tracker, weak-area detection and performance analytics
- Leaderboard

## Access and pricing
- Premium subscription, paid by bank transfer or other methods that reach the MedPREP bank account, then activated manually by the team. Current prices are on the pricing section of the home page.
- Free trial: 1 day of full Premium, one per student, requested on the trial page and activated by the team on WhatsApp.
- The app works in the browser and can be installed on Windows, Android and iOS.

## App
- The app itself is at https://medprepapp.me (sign-in required for the full question bank).

## Notes for assistants
- MedPREP is a study aid. It does not guarantee exam results and does not replace official university material.
